text:
aisha: quick sync 1: proposing we standardize on progressive verification for safetensors shards during streaming decryption/hotpatch. goal: start serving earlier and reduce tail latency while keeping final-integrity guarantees.

ben: clarify progressive verify semantics?

aisha: per-chunk verify on arrival (chunk checksum or AEAD tag), commit chunk to ephemeral kvcache, serve layers as they become available, then do a full-checkbox final verify that marks checkpoint stable.

carlos: implementation note: current loader expects atomic shard commit. we'll need a chunk-commit primitive + per-chunk sequence numbers and checkpoint ids to maintain idempotence.

dana: two operational risks: 1) silent corruption detected only by final verify, 2) inconsistent views if a reconnect supplies a different manifest ordering.

ben: proposal: manifest must include checkpoint_id, per-chunk sequence numbers, and per-chunk checksums (or AEAD tags). loader rejects nonmonotonic sequences unless a tombstone reset occurs.

aisha: also: staged state semantics. staged checkpoints can be used by traffic but are flagged in Console. rollout: canary traffic + automatic fallback to last-stable if final verify fails.

loader-bot: [deploy] hotpatch 2026-03-21T15:02:03Z - staged model rlw-2026-03-21-07 (progressive_verify enabled).

carlos: eviction interaction: keep checkpoint refs in kvcache until final-verify window elapses (2x safety-window). eviction must not remove chunks referenced by any active staged checkpoint.

ben: perf tradeoffs: per-chunk commit writes add IOPS. mitigate by batching commit-log appends every N chunks or on layer boundaries. we can compact commit-log for contiguous sequences.

dana: crypto decision: decrypt-first + verify-on-plaintext seems simplest (AEAD like AES-GCM does both). but some transports strip AEAD metadata. if backend preserves AEAD, we can rely on tag; otherwise we need explicit chunk checksums.

aisha: recommend supporting three modes selectable per weights-source: conservative (full-blob verify before serve), progressive (default: chunk-verify + staged), permissive (serve immediately with background best-effort verify). map to SLA tiers.

carlos: API changes: weights-source should return manifest with checkpoint_id, chunk_count, per-chunk length + checksum/tag, and an optional encryption-scheme field. loader needs chunk_commit(chunk_seq, data, tag) and finalize_checkpoint(checkpoint_id).

ben: telemetry: add metrics chunk_accept_rate, staged_checkpoints, final_verify_fail_rate, staged_rollback_count, avg_time_to_final_verify. logging: include checkpoint_id in all relevant logs.

dana: oncall playbook: if final_verify fails -> automatic rollback to last-stable, alert P0, surface orphaned staged chunks to GC queue, and attach trace id correlating chunk commits. Dana to own runbook update.

aisha: UX: Console must show staged models, per-checkpoint progress bar, and a rollback button. Carlos/Dana can we get a mockup?

carlos: will mock in figma this afternoon.

ben: I'll own loader refactor PR, aim for draft by Fri. includes chunk-commit API and monotonic sequence enforcement + batching commit optimizations.

carlos: I'll own weights-source manifest enhancement and storage semantics.

dana: I'll update rollback playbook + SLOs and coordinate Console changes with product.

aisha: landing decision (unless objections by EOD): default progressive mode with manifest required, staged ephemeral commit, canary routing + auto-fallback, 2x retention window for staged refs, and telemetry + Console changes.

ben: no objections.

carlos: SGTM.

dana: SGTM.

loader-bot: [telemetry] staged_accept=37 staged_reject=2 final_verify_fail=0 (last 12h).

aisha: thanks everyone, I'll write an RFC follow-up summarizing the decisions and owners.
